A contingent of 50 college student volunteers from the National Service Scheme (NSS) organizes a 7-day residential community camp in an adopted rural village. Read the following case study on adolescent mental health and substance abuse prevention and answer the questions that follow:

An epidemiological survey across high schools in an industrial township reveals a disturbing rise in substance experimentation among adolescents (ages 14 to 18). 1. Peer Educators: Training respected senior student leaders as 'Peer Educators' to conduct interactive life-skills workshops on peer pressure resistance skills.
2. Guidance and Counseling: Setting up confidential student counseling cells in schools offering CBT-based stress management and emotional regulation training.
3. Community Enforcement: Strict enforcement of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act (COTPA, 2003), strictly prohibiting the sale of tobacco products within a 100-yard radius of all educational institutions.
